translations.setup.title: PSSA Setup
translations.setup.chooseDetail: Choose the default application language. All three languages will be installed.
translations.setup.tagline: Your tool for Twitch alerts and analytics
translations.setup.removeDetail: Application files and shortcuts will be removed. Your settings, alerts, media, statistics and measurements will remain on disk.
translations.setup.removedDetail: Your data remains on disk. You can reinstall PSSA at any time.
translations.setup.successDetail: PSSA is ready to use. You can launch it directly from the installer.
translations.setup.err.path: Choose an absolute path on a local drive.
translations.setup.err.root: Cannot install in the root of a drive.
translations.setup.err.profile: Choose a folder in your own Windows profile.
translations.setup.err.shared: Choose a folder separate from the all-users installation.
translations.setup.err.links: Choose a folder without links or redirects.
translations.setup.err.upgrade: An update must retain the existing folder.
translations.setup.err.system: Choose a separate application folder outside system and data folders.
translations.setup.err.empty: A new installation requires an empty or nonexistent folder.
translations.setup.err.running: Close PSSA and the standalone Agent before installing or uninstalling.
translations.setup.err.engine: Could not start the installation engine.
translations.setup.err.confirm: Installation completion could not be confirmed.
translations.setup.err.remove: Uninstallation could not be confirmed. Check the installed apps list.
translations.language.title: Language and region
translations.language.detail: No restart required. Development version: not all modules are translated yet.
translations.nav.desc.studio: Layers, animations, timeline and alert preview.
translations.nav.desc.settings: Customize the application for your setup.
translations.onboard.title: Welcome to PSSA
translations.onboard.detail: Your alerts and history stay local. Connect Twitch and optionally OBS, or start without signing in.
